_about: T26. The first audio: the A05 starter pack (apps/vr/art/audio/sfx, 20 WAVs, 48 kHz 16-bit, peak-normalised to -1 dBFS) imported as USoundWave assets under /Game/Audio/SFX by apps/vr/tools/import-sfx.ps1. Read by Session/ArenaAudio.cpp. Every cue row is one catalog row of the registry subject spatial-audio-scene-authoring (technique event-priority-concurrency-cooldown): gain, priority band, positioned or not, concurrency, cooldown. Every event row names a hook the director raises (FAudioTable::KnownEvents), the cue it plays and where the sound is placed.
_units: gainDb in dB relative to the peak-normalised file (0 = as imported; never above 0, the files already peak at -1 dBFS). Distances in centimetres (Unreal units). cutoff in Hz. cooldownMs in milliseconds. seconds is the WAV length from manifest.json actual_seconds and only counts a one-shot voice as live.
_gain: The pack is peak-normalised only (BACKLOG audio item), so equal peaks are not equal loudness. Integrated loudness of each file was measured with ffmpeg ebur128 on 2026-10-08 (n = 20 files, values in each cue's _lufs). The gain puts each cue near its band's target, before distance attenuation: threat cues -20 LUFS (they must cut through), impacts and absorb feedback -20 to -22, casts and blink -22 to -24, ward and sigil feedback -26 to -29, wrist chimes and Flow -28 to -30 (heard at the wrist, every few seconds), and the crowd bed -33 under everything (-24 for the swell on a phase break). Target figures are this card's choice, not a standard; the absolute game loudness target (registry: about -18 LKFS for handheld) is measured over play when the mix pass comes.
_masterDb: Headroom for the whole mix, added to every cue. Measured on in-engine recordings of the Brennic opening (runs/T26/audio, 2026-10-08, ffmpeg ebur128 and astats, one take each, the duel differs take to take): with no master cut a 25.2 s take read -19.7 LUFS integrated, true peak +0.3 dBFS, 64 samples at full scale (a hit-taken over a fire-impact over an incoming bolt). With -3 dB the 30.6 s acceptance take read -23.2 LUFS integrated, true peak -5.2 dBFS, so under the -1 dBTP ceiling the registry gives. The integrated level sits at the registry's console target (-24) and under its handheld one (-18); the mix pass sets the absolute target.
_maxVoices: Global one-shot budget. Critical cues are always admitted (reserved); loops are beds and are not counted against it. If a moment wants more than 12 one-shots the scene is the problem, not the limit (registry: the raised limit is a failure mode).

crowdSwell._why: DECISIONS 2026-10-07 DF-003: each phase break swells the crowd. +9 dB lifts the -33 LUFS bed to about -24 for 3.5 s, under the threat band so it never masks a telegraph.

threat._why: Sources out on the sand (opponents, telegraphs, projectiles in flight). The arena floor is about 25 m across, so the falloff covers it; the inner radius is 30 % of the falloff (12 m) so an opponent's bolt is at full level by the time it is a threat, and the low-pass darkens it toward 2 kHz with distance (registry technique attenuation-falloff-and-distance-filtering).

body._why: Sounds at the player's body and hands (absorb, hit, blink, casts). Always within the inner 4.5 m for the seated listener, so they play full and panned to the hand.

cuff._why: Wrist chimes. The cuff is diegetic (PROJECT-PLAN 6.3: 'Unlocks play a chime from the wrist'), so these are positioned at the wrist rather than positionless; at about 60 cm from the ear they are inside the inner 1.8 m.

unblockable-telegraph._why: The leave cue (plan 6.7: black core plus a low drone). The quietest-measuring threat file and mostly low frequencies, so no cut; critical, never stolen, never cooled down.

fire-bolt-incoming._why: An absorb cue that follows the projectile. Three at once covers Brennic's flick plus an ember; a fourth is the same sound thickened.

hound-snarl._why: The loudest-measuring threat file; cut 8 dB to sit with the threat band. A creatures bout has three hounds, so two snarls at once and a 200 ms gap.

hit-taken._why: An impact on the player: loud. Two at once, 50 ms apart (registry: fast impacts).

fire-impact._why: A fire hit that was not absorbed, at the target. Layered over hit-taken on the player, so one notch under the impact band.

ward-absorb._why: The absorb answer to every magic hit. A Squall is four orbs 0.25 s apart: two voices let the first two ring and drop the third, so a volley reads as a volley, not a smear.

perfect-absorb._why: The reward (the teach's bell). Bright and already loud; -2 dB keeps it at the top of the feedback band. Critical: a perfect must always be heard.

crest._why: The loudest file in the pack; -11 dB lands it at about -21.5 LUFS, the top of the cast band, because a Crest is the big cast.

cast-tide-orb._why: A heavy cast, about -22.7 LUFS after the cut.

cast-bolt._why: The most frequent cast; about -23.8 LUFS so a bolt stream does not tire the ear. Also the Water opponents' casts, at the caster.

blink._why: The dodge. One at a time (registry: singular moves). Also the air mage's Air Form, at the mage.

ward-raise._why: A confirmation, about -25.7 LUFS, under the absorb it prepares.

ward-hold-loop._why: A bed while the palm is up, about -32.5 LUFS: present, never in the way of a threat cue.

sigil-complete._why: The recognizer's yes, at the casting wrist, about -27.7 LUFS.

sigil-reject._why: The recognizer's no: clear but not harsh (cue text), about -28.6 LUFS, 300 ms apart (registry: interface alerts).

sigil-draw-loop._why: Texture while the pen is down, about -29.5 LUFS.

tier-unlock._why: The wrist chime (plan 6.3), about -28.4 LUFS. A phase surge unlocks the player's tier in the same tick, so the 300 ms cooldown keeps the surge to one chime.

flow-stack._why: Every few seconds in a good stretch, so quiet: about -29.9 LUFS, at the ward bracer where the beads are (plan 6.3).

ui-pause._why: Soft and quiet (cue text): about -28.8 LUFS, at the cuff.

arena-crowd-loop._why: The only stereo file: a bed that surrounds the seat, so positionless (registry two-d-vs-three-d: a source with no single location). -20 dB puts it at about -33 LUFS under the whole bout.

events._when: A new unblockable telegraph, or an opponent's pending cast of an unblockable spell (Sunfall, Tempest Lance, Leviathan Orb); one per activation.
A new magic projectile owned by a Fire-school opponent (Brennic's bolts, hound embers). The voice follows the projectile.
A hound's spit windup starts (DF-004 option A).
A Fire-school hit that was not absorbed by the player's ward or dome.
A hit on the player with no ward or dome up.
A hit on the player with the ward or the dome up, not a perfect.
Kernel perfect on the player.
The player's absorb turns on.
Loop while the player's absorb is on.
Kernel roll by the player (the blink).
Kernel cast by the player of any line but Tide Orb.
Kernel cast by the player of a Tide Orb tier.
The player's Crest count goes up.
The player's Flow goes up.
Kernel unlock for the player.
Kernel phase (a rival's HP-gated break surges both tier clocks).
The recognizer accepts a sigil (session cue).
The recognizer rejects a path, or a split cast is refused (session cue).
Loop while a sigil pen is down (hand or mouse).
The session pauses.
Kernel cast by a Water-school opponent (Fire opponents are heard through their incoming bolts).
Kernel airform: the air mage takes Air Form.
Loop while a bout is active and not paused.
Kernel phase: the crowd loop swells by crowdSwell.gainDb for crowdSwell.seconds.
